title: KOCKKROCH 'Standing Out' Acid Wash 240 GSM Oversized T-Shirt
body_html:
DROP 013 // CALIBRATED TO SURVIVE. STANDING OUT INSTEAD OF FITTING IN.

Constructed from ultra-dense 240 GSM combed cotton treated with a proprietary mineral acid-wash finish, this piece embodies the raw architectural tension between brutalist skyline geometry and bio-mechanical survival.

GRAPHIC & ARTWORK SPECIFICATIONS

  • Chest Graphic: Architectural skyline silhouette typography spelling 'KOCKKROCH' with micro-window grid textures and the brand thesis: 'standing out instead of fitting in.'
  • Back Artwork: Signature bio-mechanical cockroach exoskeleton line-art shield spanning across the upper back and shoulder blades in high-density plastisol discharge ink.
  • Print Finish: Breathable, crack-resistant high-definition screen print that softens with every wash without fading.

FABRIC & CONSTRUCTION

  • Material: 100% Super-Combed Ring-Spun Cotton.
  • Fabric Weight: Heavyweight 240 GSM (Grams per Square Meter).
  • Treatment: Custom hand-finished mineral acid wash for a unique vintage charcoal patina on each individual garment.
  • Collar: Heavy 1.2-inch ribbed crewneck collar designed to retain shape after extensive wear.
  • Stitching: Reinforced twin-needle construction on sleeves and bottom hem.
  • Pre-Shrunk: Biowashed and silicon softened to prevent post-wash shrinkage.

SILHOUETTE & FIT GUIDE

  • Fit: Contemporary boxy streetwear oversized fit with exaggerated dropped shoulders.
  • Sizing Recommendation: True to oversized fit. For a standard fit, order one size down.
  • Model Stats: Model is 6'1" (185 cm), wearing Size L.

CARE INSTRUCTIONS

  • Machine wash cold inside-out with like colors.
  • Use mild liquid detergent. Do not bleach.
  • Tumble dry low or hang dry in shade (recommended).
  • Do not iron directly on front or back print artwork.

SHIPPING & GUARANTEE

  • Dispatch: Orders dispatched within 24 to 48 hours from our California / India fulfillment hubs.
  • Exchanges: 15-day hassle-free size exchange guarantee.
  • Payment: Secure checkout via UPI, Cards, Net Banking & Cash on Delivery (COD).

title: KOCKKROCH 'Numerical Code' 210 GSM Oversized T-Shirt

FABRIC & CONSTRUCTION

  • Fabric Weight: Mid-Heavyweight 210 GSM (Solid structured drape with zero sheer).
  • Colorway: Pitch Black.
  • Collar: Reinforced ribbed crew collar with shoulder-to-shoulder herringbone taping.
  • Fabric Tech: Pre-washed and pre-shrunk for zero post-purchase dimensional change.
